prompts.background:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one continuous vertical environment painting for a scrolling illustrated website, 1:2 aspect ratio, ideally 1536 x 3072 pixels.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the existing continuous amber sunset, mountain, lake and lower forest landscape. Image 2 is only a STYLE/OBJECT REFERENCE for the vermilion torii gate in its forest, not a layout template. Never reproduce the reference's UI, text, panels, or multiple vignettes.
Primary request: preserve the entire coherent composition, camera, painterly photographic fantasy rendering, detailed vegetation, sunset lighting and rich amber/cherry/forest palette of Image 1. Carefully add one modest distant warm vermilion Japanese torii/shrine gate to the upper stair landing within its lower forest.
Composition: all coordinates are normalized relative to the WHOLE tall image, x from left, y from top. Torii gate feet centered around (0.605,0.728), its top around y=0.670, full gate width about 0.140 of the image width. It belongs naturally in perspective on the upper landing. Realistic subtle weathering, wooden crossbar and pillars, grounded contact shadows. This is a restrained distant gate, not an oversized foreground landmark. Keep the stairway and forest unbroken.
Provide one small flat mossy rock landing around (0.50,0.75) for a separately composited rabbit; no rabbit or other animal in the image. Preserve the right-side upper river/stream and naturally continue it toward (0.77,0.80), ready to connect to a lower foreground waterfall. Preserve the full upper sunset, mountains, mist, lake and flowing sequence; only make the smallest required lower-forest edits.
Constraints: one continuous landscape edge-to-edge, no scene panels, no collage, no UI, no type, no borders, no watermark. No close house, no people, no animals. No transparency. Preserve the original tall aspect ratio and composition.
prompts.foreground:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: ONE integrated close forest foreground terrain plate with TRUE TRANSPARENT background, square 1:1 canvas, ideally 2048 x 2048 pixels.
Input images: Image 1 is a STYLE/LIGHTING REFERENCE of the continuous landscape into whose lower forest this foreground must blend; Image 2 is a MATERIAL/ARCHITECTURE REFERENCE for a Japanese cedar veranda and warm lantern; Image 3 is a STYLE/COMPOSITION REFERENCE only. Create a new cohesive foreground plate. Do not reproduce any reference UI, text, panel, montage, rabbit or torii.
Primary request: a broad, richly detailed Japanese forest foreground landscape that covers the ENTIRE lower canvas width, with one close cedar veranda/house on the RIGHT integrated into mossy rocks, ferns, stream banks and a strong vertical waterfall. It must feel like one connected environment plate, not a separate floating house cutout.
All following coordinates are normalized to the square canvas. House occupies x=0.72 to 1.00, its roof top at y=0.04 and porch/base near y=0.52, cropped naturally at the right edge. Detailed warm cedar beams, subdued amber shoji glow, one warm paper lantern, gently weathered dark tiled eaves. The house foundation blends organically into the terrain.
The entire bottom band roughly y=0.60 to 1.00 is opaque connected terrain across the FULL canvas width: wet black rocks, moss, ferns, quiet dark vegetation to the left, stream bed to the right. Its upper silhouette is irregular and organic. No rectangular horizon line.
An incoming stream begins near (0.77,0.38), spills over the rocks around y=0.46 and becomes an obvious continuous fairly VERTICAL white waterfall ribbon within x=0.68 to 0.78, flowing down through y=1.00. Dark wet rocks frame the drop. Direction is down, suitable for downward streak animation. Waterfall white strands, subtle spray, highlights reflect warm forest light.
Place a flat DRY mossy rock ledge centered near (0.86,0.67) on the RIGHT side of the waterfall, for a separate panda character. This ledge continues as a traversable path to the right edge at the same height, so the panda can run right without crossing any waterfall. Keep this ledge empty.
TRANSPARENCY IS CRITICAL: upper-left and central regions, especially x=0 to 0.70 and y=0 to 0.40, are truly transparent alpha so a distant shrine/background remains visible. Empty areas between architecture supports and above the organic terrain silhouette are also genuinely transparent. No sky, mountain backplate, opaque filled empty background, checkerboard painted into image, or rectangular scenic strip.
Style: match Image 1's highly detailed painterly photographic fantasy material palette, rich forest greens, amber late sun from upper-left, cherry-warm reflected light, convincing scale, grounding and natural shadows. Avoid overly cartoonish simplification.
Constraints: exactly one connected broad foreground plate, no panda, no rabbit, no gate, no people, no text, no UI, no watermark. Preserve true alpha.
prompts.panda:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent animation sprite atlas, EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS by 3 ROWS, 12 equally sized SQUARE cells in row-major order; canvas 2048 x 1536 pixels if possible.
Primary request: the SAME cute realistic storybook BLACK-AND-WHITE GIANT PANDA in every cell, consistent anatomy, identity, scale, camera and soft detailed fur. Warm late-afternoon light from upper-left, natural black fur and creamy white fur, small tasteful expressive eyes. NOT a red panda.
Layout: invisible 4x3 equal-square grid, no drawn lines or labels. Every panda full body entirely within its own square, ample transparent margin with no clipping. Consistent foot-contact baseline near 86 percent of each cell height. Keep standing ears well inside the cell. Seated body 75 percent cell height or less; standing pose taller but same physical scale. Truly transparent empty background; no scenery, no big cast shadow, at most a tiny subtle contact shadow beneath feet.
Pose assignment, row-major indexed 0 through 11:
Top row, cells 0,1,2,3: seated three-quarter facing viewer/right, happily eating golden honey from a SMALL PIECE OF HONEYCOMB held in paws, clearly amber honey; four subtly different nibble/lick paw and head poses for a gentle loop. No jar or bowl.
Middle row cell 4: still seated, notices viewer, pauses chewing, mildly curious expression.
Middle row cell 5: beginning to rise from seated position, natural anatomy.
Middle row cell 6: fully standing briefly on hind legs, paws raised lightly, full feet and ears visible.
Middle row cell 7: turns RIGHT and drops onto all fours, preparing to run.
Bottom row cells 8,9,10,11: strict side-view galloping to the RIGHT, four distinct successive smooth stride phases (extended, gathering, compressed, pushing off), consistent registration, speed, body scale and identity; no honeycomb in these running frames.
Constraints: exactly 12 figures, one per cell, exactly 4 columns and 3 rows, same giant panda, plausible limbs, no duplicate stray paws, no clipping, no numbers, labels, text, grid, borders, scenery, watermark, or painted checkerboard. Preserve genuine transparent alpha between and around every character.
prompts.water: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a transparent moving-water texture for a waterfall in an illustrated Japanese forest website. Output portrait 1:2 aspect ratio, ideally 1024 x 2048. ONLY delicate silver-white, cool pearl and faint warm-gold water streaks and thin rippling vertical ribbons falling straight down. A layered mix of long fine irregular strands, tiny foam droplets and translucent smooth ribbons, with clear transparent gaps between all streams. True alpha transparent background, absolutely no black, blue or gray filled background. Feather the left and right edges to full transparency. The pattern should repeat vertically: top and bottom have similar continuous thin strands to allow seamless downward scrolling. No cliff, rock, forest, horizon, pool, water splash base, objects, lettering, border or watermark. Detailed photographic-painterly water highlights, not a solid white slab, not horizontal waves, not a broad opaque curtain. It will overlay an already painted white waterfall at low opacity. Keep the actual water highlights mostly within the middle 75% of the image width.
